title: Animal Sounds
statement:
Make animals speak through one shared base type. A plain animal says `...`, and a dog and a cat each override that with their own sound.

The first line is a count `n` (at least 1). Each of the next `n` lines holds one animal kind, a single lowercase word. Build the matching animal for each kind and print what it says, one sound per line, in input order:

- `dog` says `Woof`
- `cat` says `Meow`
- any other kind is a plain animal and says `...`

Call the speak action through the base animal type, so each animal picks its own sound.

Input:

```text
4
dog
cat
dog
cow
```

Expected output:

```text
Woof
Meow
Woof
...
```
hints: A subclass replaces a method by defining one with the same name. The base version stays for every kind you do not override.
The function that builds each animal only has to pick the right class. Printing the sound already works through the base type.
